meeting.title: Northstar Labs pilot and security review
meeting.summary: Northstar wants a five-person pilot, but legal review is blocked until it receives security material.
meeting.transcript:
Maya Chen: What would you need to move forward with a pilot?
Carla Ruiz: The eight-thousand-pound quarterly budget is approved.
Carla Ruiz: Legal will not begin its review until it has your security questionnaire and data-retention policy. Could you send both by Monday afternoon?
Maya Chen: Yes, I will send both by Monday afternoon.
Carla Ruiz: If legal is comfortable, we would like the pilot to begin on 12 October.

required_evidence_excerpts: Legal will not begin its review until it has your security questionnaire and data-retention policy.
Could you send both by Monday afternoon?

meeting.title: Harbour Analytics discovery call
meeting.summary: Harbour is interested and requested a relevant case study before an internal discussion next week.
meeting.transcript:
Leo Grant: Does the workflow sound relevant to your team?
Nina Shah: Potentially, but we are still exploring options and do not have an approved project yet.
Nina Shah: Could you send the retail case study when you get a chance? We will discuss it at our planning meeting next week.
Leo Grant: Yes, I will send it over.

required_evidence_excerpts: Could you send the retail case study when you get a chance?
We will discuss it at our planning meeting next week.

meeting.title: Cedar Partners introductory conversation
meeting.summary: Cedar is not evaluating outbound tools this year and requested no proposal.
meeting.transcript:
Ava Cole: Would it be useful if I sent a proposal?
Tom Reed: We are not evaluating outbound tools this year. Please do not send a proposal. I will get back in touch if our priorities change.
Ava Cole: Understood, I will leave it with you.

required_evidence_excerpts: We are not evaluating outbound tools this year.
Please do not send a proposal.
